algorithm: {**This algorithm is an adaptive simulated annealing with a polynomial mutation strategy and a dynamic cooling schedule that tries to balance exploration and exploitation for efficient global optimization of non-convex functions.**}

{The proposed algorithm is a hybrid of Differential Evolution (DE) and Simulated Annealing (SA), which combines the global exploration capabilities of DE with the adaptability of SA to efficiently search for the global minimum of the Rosenbrock function.}
